feature: Internal transfer picking is one-press: tapping a guidance row's Pick button (or a bare part scan) picks the whole reservation row capped at the item's remaining qty — the qty prompt is gone; the admin internal-transfer order list gains a per-row Confirm/Unconfirm button (same pending ↔ allocated endpoint as the detail page)
reason: Requiring operators to type the qty every pick is slow and error-prone — pressing Pick should just mark that reservation picked; and with ~10k synced orders, opening each detail page to confirm is impractical
remarks: Implemented 2026-11-17. PDA `pages/internal-transfer/[id].vue` pick() picks min(row qty, remaining) with no prompt; unused pickQtyPrompt/pickQtyInvalid i18n keys removed from the three locales. Admin `pages/internal-transfer-orders/index.vue` new actions column with Confirm (pending → allocated) / Unconfirm (allocated → pending) via flow.setInternalTransferStatus + per-row busy state. The PDA queue already only lists confirmed (allocated/picking/issue) orders — no change needed there.
